### Issues
[HIGH][statement-contradiction] F1 expose_tools operation is outside the closed log vocabulary
File: internal/observe/envelope.go:157-161 (also log.go:90-96, httpdiagnostics.go:660-666, log_test.go:428-433)
Confidence: HIGH
Issue: buildEnvelope rewrites any entry whose Operation is absent from operationVocabulary into `log_vocabulary_violation`; the list holds only search_tools/describe_tool/call_tool/retrieve_result. §7's expose_tools `mcp_complete` and every `logAdmissionFailure(...,"expose_tools",...)` therefore become warn violations. §7 claims the label set is unchanged and the envelope allows production writes only to schema.go/tools.go/session_exposure.go, so T3 log assertions and T4 verification cannot pass as scoped.
Fix: authorize internal/observe/httpdiagnostics.go (add "expose_tools") plus the log_test.go mirror; list it in the envelope/T3.

[HIGH][statement-contradiction] F2 T2 requires expose_tools before T3 creates it
File: T2 ledger (:356-364 rewrite) vs T3 deps T1,T2; T2 validation exit 0
Confidence: HIGH
Issue: rewriting the post-discovery listing/calls "to require an explicit expose_tools first" invokes a tool the SDK registers only in T3; T2's GREEN gate is unsatisfiable and T3 depends on T2.
Fix: T2 asserts absence/rejection only (AC5); move the positive post-expose rewrite to T3 (add progressive_discovery_test.go to T3 files), or change the ordering.

Fix: retarget the inversion to :257-269; keep :272-296 unchanged.

[MEDIUM][r-ac-coverage-gap] F4 cancelled-search test becomes vacuous
File: progressive_discovery_test.go:516-520; projection.go:1040-1041
Confidence: MEDIUM
Issue: cancelCall() is reachable only via testBeforeRegistryAdd, which applyRegistryDelta calls only through commitDiscovery. R1 removes search's commit, so the hook never fires, the context is never cancelled, and the renamed test only repeats no-fanout.
Fix: cancel independently (searcher hook/deadline) while asserting the hook is not invoked and state is unchanged; or drop the cancellation claim.
